name: Rear Sway Bar
description: Rear stabilizer bar clamped to the rear cradle with end links down to the rear knuckles. ZL1 1LE has a three-position adjustable bar. Race options: adjustable bars and spherical end links.

components.name: Rear stabilizer bar
components.description: Torsion bar mounted on the rear cradle; its ends connect through end links to the knuckles (direct-acting). On the ZL1 1LE, three attachment holes per side: rearward holes approx +15% stiffness, forward holes approx -10% vs the middle (GM). A primary balance-tuning tool at the track.
components.location: On rear cradle behind the differential, approx x 3.08-3.12, y 0.42, arms forward to approx x 2.95, z +/-0.60.

factory.name: GM rear stabilizer shaft; ZL1 1LE three-way adjustable (RPO FEA)

raceOptions.name: BMR SB054 adjustable rear sway bar
raceOptions.notes: 4 x 10 mm-head bolts in supplied bushings and links at 35 ft-lb (BMR hardware).

installNotes: Set both sides to the same hole.

Chevrolet 2019 Camaro ZL1 product guide (suspension types, ZF EPS, track 1610/1591 mm, DSSV, 3-way rear bar)

modelRef.features: Bar behind the cradle rear cross member; 1LE arms have 3 holes (3-way adjustable)

components.name: Rear sway bar insulators and clamps
components.description: Rubber insulators in clamps bolted to the rear cradle. GM lists the clamp bolts as torque-to-yield.

hardware.spec: Flange bolt; GM P/N 11588723 (per BMR list)
hardware.torqueSequence: Install the bar with the car at curb height on jack stands, then tighten the 4 clamp bolts to 58 N·m. GM gives no angle step.
hardware.notes: Per clamp. BMR SB054 instructions mention 10 mm-head stock bolts and 35 ft-lb for their bushings. [2026-10 check] Confirmed in GM SC1 kit sheets 84242387/84401189 and the 1LE kit sheet 84233246 (58 N·m, 43 lb ft, 4 bolts, no angle). Same value as before.

components.name: Rear sway bar end links
components.description: Links from the bar ends down to a bushing/bolt on the rear knuckle. The top is a ball stud (15 mm nut, 5-6 mm hex hold); the bottom is a through-bolt in a bushing.
components.location: Bar end approx (x 2.95, y 0.42, z +/-0.60) down to knuckle approx (x 2.93, y 0.28, z +/-0.66).

raceOptions.name: BMR ELK015 adjustable end links
raceOptions.notes: Rear lower: supplied 10 x 60 mm bolt + washer, blue Loctite, 33 ft-lb; offset bushing narrow side away from knuckle; grease lower bushings.

raceOptions.name: SPL Parts RE CAM6 rear swaybar endlinks

hardware.spec: Ball-stud nut, 15 mm, hold with 5 mm hex
hardware.torqueSequence: Tighten at curb height. Hold the ball stud with a hex key so it cannot rotate.
hardware.notes: [2026-10 check] Confirmed in the GM 2019 Camaro Track Preparation Guide (ZL1 1LE adjustable rear bar: 43 N·m, 32 lb ft) and in the GM SC1/1LE kit sheets (84242387, 84233246). Same value as before.

installNotes: Set link length for zero bar preload at ride height with driver weight.
inspection: Check jam nuts and rod-end play.
